description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [ATK and MAG +30%, DEF +25% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Twin Element Mode III (Ice, Dark)] to the user

description.name: Sheer Cold
description.text: 4/6/8 single hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.05 each) scaling with activations, grants [(Dark/Ice) Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user

description.name: Cold Steel
description.text: Four single hybrid attacks (0.85/0.90/0.95 or 2.90/3.05/3.20 each) scaling with [Cold Steel Uses], causes [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] every second activation

description.name: Twin Element Mode III (Ice, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] after using a Ice/Dark ability

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
